objects.name: Analytic 1673
objects.description: For Android, detect Evade Analysis Environment primarily during application vetting or controlled analysis rather than assuming a live device SOC feed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: APK or IPA contains SystemProperties.get() calls, Runtime.exec getprop invocations, or code patterns checking for emulator artifacts (ro.product.model=sdk, IMEI=000000, screen size, sensor absence) — static detection of environment-check co]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
